lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six distinct vertical columns and four horizontal rows, forming a structured geometric grid across the lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, nearly parallel vertical linear indentations are visible on the mid-lateral flank, which interrupt the natural spot distribution and suggest significant tissue compression or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the posterior-ventral surface of the visible pectoral fin.
